sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作插入语(born of...)交代起源 + from...into... 由"贫民之舞"到"世界符号"的升华 + recognised and loved 过去分词并列作后置定语,凝练有力

original_sentence: the dancers twisted and turned, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
readingExamples: the dancers twisted and turned, and the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
definitionEn:
(1) v. to turn or bend something repeatedly, or to turn part of your body around
(2) v. to wind or wrap things around each other; to curve or wind (of a road, river, etc.)
(3) v. to injure a joint by turning it suddenly and awkwardly
(4) v. to change the meaning of words or facts deliberately and unfairly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (情节的)意外转折;出人意料的变化
uncommonMeanings.example: The story took a sudden twist when the shabby beggar the children had mocked all winter turned out to be the very stranger who would one day leave them his entire fortune. （读后续写·反转·因果）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 歪曲;曲解(话语、事实)
uncommonMeanings.example: However carefully she chose her words, the newspaper twisted them until the woman who had risked her life to save a child was made to look like a reckless fool. （议论文·舆论·断章取义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 扭伤(关节)
uncommonMeanings.example: She twisted her ankle badly on the final descent, yet she gritted her teeth, leaned on her friend's shoulder and limped every last mile to the finish line. （读后续写·受伤·坚持）

posExamples.sentence: The dancers twisted and turned in a blur of feathers and light, their bodies bending to the drumbeat as if the music itself were pulling invisible strings, and I felt my own feet begin to move against my will. （读后续写·狂欢·律动）
Please do not twist the safety valve too far to the right, as over-tightening it may damage the seal and cause the machine to leak. （应用文·操作说明/须知）
Those who twist the truth for short-term gain may win an argument today, but they slowly forfeit the one thing no clever words can ever buy back — the trust of the people around them. （议论文·诚信）

The narrow mountain path twisted upward through the pines, doubling back on itself so often that the weary travellers began to fear the summit was nothing more than a cruel and beautiful lie. （读后续写·登山·艰险）

idioms.example: By a strange twist of fate, the very rival who had once cost him the championship became, years later, the coach who guided his son to gold. （读后续写·命运·因果轮回）

idioms.translation: (半开玩笑地)极力劝说;施压逼迫某人
idioms.example: "You don't need to twist my arm," she laughed, already reaching for her coat; a chance to see the sea again was the easiest 'yes' she had ever given. （读后续写·邀约·爽快）

idioms.translation: (道路/河流)蜿蜒曲折;辗转反侧
idioms.example: The road twisted and turned along the cliff edge, and with every hairpin bend the drop below yawned wider and the driver's knuckles grew a shade whiter. （读后续写·险途·紧张）

idioms.idiom: twist sb round one's little finger
idioms.translation: 把某人玩弄于股掌之间;任意摆布
idioms.example: The clever child could twist her grandfather round her little finger, and one pleading look was enough to melt every stern rule he had ever laid down. （读后续写·祖孙·亲情）

collocations.example: As the samba quickened, the dancers twisted and turned in perfect time, and the crowd, unable to hold still a moment longer, surged forward to join them. （读后续写·狂欢·感染）
He twisted his wrist in the fall, but he tucked the pain away, smiled at the anxious children, and finished pitching the tent as though nothing at all had happened. （读后续写·坚忍·体贴）
With trembling hands she twisted open the rusted lid of the tin, and there, wrapped in yellowed paper, lay the letter her mother had hidden fifty years before. （读后续写·发现·尘封往事）

collocations.phrase: twist the truth / twist sb's words
collocations.translation: 歪曲事实/曲解某人的话
collocations.example: It is all too easy to twist a person's words online, stripping away every trace of context until a harmless remark blazes into a public scandal. （议论文·网络舆论）

collocations.phrase: a twist in the plot / a plot twist
collocations.example: Just when the reader is certain how the tale must end, a final twist in the plot turns everything on its head and lends the whole story a startling new meaning. （议论文/读后续写·叙事技巧）
The little boy twisted and squirmed in his seat throughout the long ceremony, until at last his mother's gentle hand settled him with a single reassuring squeeze. （读后续写·童趣·亲情）

collocations.phrase: give sth a twist / add a twist to sth
collocations.example: The young chef gave the humble family recipe a modern twist, and the dish that had fed three generations suddenly won a place on the city's finest menu. （读后续写·创新·传承）
Pain twisted his features for the briefest instant before pride smoothed them again, and he assured us, through clenched teeth, that he was perfectly fine. （读后续写·忍痛·尊严）

synonyms.example: She turned the ancient key slowly, and with a groan of protesting iron the door swung inward onto a room untouched for half a century. （读后续写·探秘·悬念）
synonyms.usage: turn 是最普通的"转动/转弯",动作单一;twist 强调"扭动、拧转",常含反复、用力或身体的弯曲,画面感更强,也可指情节反转、歪曲事实等抽象义

synonyms.example: The little stream wound lazily through the meadow, catching the last of the evening light in its slow silver curves. （读后续写·环境·宁静）
synonyms.usage: wind 侧重"平缓地蜿蜒、缠绕",常写河流、道路、藤蔓;twist 蜿蜒时更强调急促、曲折、反复(twist and turn),动态更强烈

synonyms.example: Fear has a way of distorting memory, so that the harmless shadow he passed becomes, in the retelling, a monster with glowing eyes. （议论文·记忆与心理）
synonyms.usage: distort 是较正式的"扭曲、使失真",可指形状、声音、事实;twist 作"歪曲"讲更口语、更具体,常指故意曲解话语或事实(twist sb's words)

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. twisted and turned as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The dancers twisted and turned as if the very drumbeat had reached inside them and set their bones alight, and I felt the same wild rhythm tugging at my own reluctant feet. （twist and turn 写舞动 + as if 虚拟夸张 + set their bones alight 隐喻内在的燃烧,感官描写渲染狂欢）

advancedExpressions.expression: please do not twist ... too far, as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please do not twist the knob too far in either direction, as forcing it may strip the thread and render the whole device useless. （祈使句 do not twist... + as 引导原因,说明书/须知类应用文的规范警示句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who twist the truth may ..., but they forfeit ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who twist the truth for a moment's advantage may silence a critic today, but they quietly forfeit the trust that, once lost, no apology can ever fully restore. （those who... 泛指主语 + may...but... 转折让步 + forfeit the trust 点出代价,诚信主题的经典论证结构）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dancers twisted and turned to the music.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To the pounding pulse of the drums the dancers twisted and turned, their bodies flowing like water one instant and snapping like whips the next, until it was impossible to tell where the music ended and the movement began. （读后续写·舞蹈·动态美）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 状语前置(To the pounding pulse...)定基调 + like water / like whips 一柔一刚双重明喻 + until it was impossible to tell... 虚实交融升华,写出人乐合一

sentenceUpgrade.original: The road was very winding and dangerous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The mountain road twisted and turned along the sheer cliff face, each blind bend swallowing the last, so that the drivers could do nothing but trust the crumbling edge and pray. （读后续写·险途·紧张）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: twist and turn 生动化"蜿蜒" + each...swallowing the last 分词写弯道相接的连绵 + could do nothing but... 强调无助感 + trust...and pray 收束制造悬念

original_sentence: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
readingExamples: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing
definitionEn:
(1) vi. & vt. to hit your hands together repeatedly to show approval, enjoyment or to get attention
(2) vt. to put or place something somewhere quickly and firmly
(3) vt. to hit someone in a friendly way, usually on the back or shoulder
(4) n. a sudden loud noise, especially of thunder; the act or sound of clapping

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 迅速(而有力)地放上;猛地拍上
uncommonMeanings.example: The instant he glimpsed the surprise gift, the boy clapped a hand over his mouth, his eyes shining above his fingers with a joy too big for any words. （读后续写·惊喜·无言）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (雷的)一声轰响;霹雳
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden clap of thunder split the silence, and the frightened horses reared and bolted into the rain-lashed darkness before anyone could seize the reins. （读后续写·暴风雨·惊变）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 友好地拍(某人的肩/背)
uncommonMeanings.example: The old coach clapped him warmly on the shoulder and said, in a voice rough with feeling, that no medal in the world could measure how proud he was. （读后续写·师徒·鼓励）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the dancers finished, the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing all at once, hundreds of hands beating the air together until the whole square seemed to shake with sheer, unstoppable delight. （读后续写·狂欢·全场沸腾）
At the end of each performance, please clap warmly to encourage the young performers, and kindly refrain from taking flash photographs during the show. （应用文·观演须知）
We are quick to clap our hands for the champion who crosses the line first, yet true respect belongs no less to the last runner who, though far behind, refuses to give up. （议论文·体育精神）
A deafening clap of thunder rolled across the valley, and in the sudden silence that followed, the frightened child crept closer and slipped a small trembling hand into mine. （读后续写·暴风雨·亲情）

idioms.example: The moment she clapped eyes on the ramshackle little cottage, ivy climbing its crooked walls, she knew beyond all doubt that she had come home at last. （读后续写·一见倾心·归属）

idioms.translation: 把某人投入牢狱;给某人戴上镣铐
idioms.example: In the harsh old days a starving man might be clapped in prison merely for stealing a loaf of bread to feed his crying children. （议论文·历史·法与情）

idioms.idiom: give sb a clap / a big hand
idioms.example: "Let's give our youngest volunteer a big clap!" the host cried, and the applause that followed brought a shy, delighted flush to the little girl's cheeks. （读后续写·表彰·温情）

collocations.example: She clapped her hands with childlike delight when the first snow of the year came drifting past the classroom window. （读后续写·童真·喜悦）
As the float rolled by, the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing, and for one shining moment every stranger on that street felt like family. （读后续写·狂欢·共鸣）
The audience clapped so warmly and for so long that the trembling young pianist finally dared to look up and smile. （读后续写·舞台·肯定）

collocations.phrase: a round of applause / a clap
collocations.example: A thunderous round of applause swept through the hall the instant the last note faded, and the singer bowed again and again, unable to hold back her tears. （读后续写·演出·感动）

collocations.phrase: clap sb on the back / shoulder
collocations.translation: 拍某人的背/肩(表示鼓励或祝贺)
collocations.example: His teammates crowded round to clap him on the back, and the boy who had once been too shy to speak now grinned like the whole world belonged to him. （读后续写·团队·认可）
With a sudden clap of thunder the storm broke, and the picnickers snatched up their baskets and ran, laughing and shrieking, for the shelter of the trees. （读后续写·天气突变·慌乱）

collocations.phrase: clap one's hand(s) over / to sth
collocations.example: She clapped a hand to her mouth to smother the gasp, for she had just recognised, in the faded photograph, the face of the stranger who had saved her life. （读后续写·震惊·发现）
Soon the whole crowd was clapping along to the samba, and even the shyest tourist, swept up in the rhythm, found her hands moving of their own accord. （读后续写·狂欢·融入）

synonyms.example: The whole auditorium rose to applaud the young inventor, whose small quiet idea had grown into something that would change countless lives. （议论文/读后续写·赞许）
synonyms.usage: applaud 较正式,既可指"鼓掌"这一动作,也常引申为"赞赏、称许"(applaud a decision);clap 更口语、更具体,专指"拍手"这一物理动作

synonyms.example: As the exhausted runner staggered across the line, the crowd rose to cheer, and the roar of thousands of voices seemed to carry him the final desperate steps. （读后续写·赛场·鼓舞）
synonyms.usage: cheer 是"高声欢呼、喝彩",用嗓音表达兴奋;clap 是"拍手",用手表达赞许。二者常并列出现(cheer and clap),但方式不同

synonyms.example: The nurse patted the frightened old man's hand gently, and something in that small, wordless kindness eased the fear in his tired eyes. （读后续写·安慰·温情）
synonyms.usage: pat 指"轻轻地拍",力度小、动作温柔(pat sb's hand/head);clap 作"拍"讲时力度较大、动作利落(clap sb on the back),二者力度与语气不同

advancedExpressions.expression: the crowd began to cheer, clap and sing, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: The crowd began to cheer, clap and sing, until the very ground beneath our feet seemed to tremble with a joy no single heart could have held alone. （三动词并列铺陈动作 + until 引导结果 + 夸张(the ground trembled)渲染集体欢腾,狂欢高潮段落收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: please clap warmly to ..., and kindly refrain from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please clap warmly to encourage every performer, and kindly refrain from talking or using your phone once the lights go down. （祈使句 please... and kindly refrain from... 一正一反,礼貌规范,观演须知类应用文标配）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are quick to clap for ..., yet ... deserves no less
advancedExpressions.example: We are quick to clap for the winner who dazzles the crowd, yet the quiet worker who never seeks the spotlight deserves our applause no less. （we are quick to... 揭示常见倾向 + yet 转折 + no less 强调平等价值,引导深层反思的论证句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The crowd clapped and cheered when the dance ended.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant the last dancer froze in her final pose, the crowd erupted, cheering, clapping and stamping as one, and the roar of it rolled down the street like a wave that refused to break. （读后续写·谢幕·沸腾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant... 引导瞬时反应 + erupted 化静为动 + 三个现在分词并列(cheering, clapping, stamping)叠加动作 + like a wave that refused to break 明喻延展声浪的持久

sentenceUpgrade.original: People clapped for the winner, but the others tried hard too.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We are always ready to clap for the one who finishes first, but the courage of those who stumble, rise and press on to the very end is surely no less worthy of our applause. （议论文·价值论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be always ready to... 概括普遍现象 + but 转折 + stumble, rise and press on 三动词递进写坚持 + no less worthy of... 比较结构强调平等的敬意,升华论点

original_sentence: The whole group started marching down the street.
readingExamples: The whole group started marching down the street.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to walk with regular steps as a group, especially soldiers or marchers moving together
(2) vi. to walk somewhere quickly and in a determined way, often because you are angry or have a clear purpose
(3) vi. to take part in an organized public demonstration by walking through a place
(4) n. an organized walk by many people to express protest or support, or the act of marching

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 强行押送，迫使（某人）走
uncommonMeanings.example: Without a word, the stern headmaster marched the trembling boy down the corridor to the office, his grip tightening with every echoing footstep. （读后续写·校园冲突·被押送的紧张）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间、事件不可阻挡的）进程，推移
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing before the crumbling castle, she felt the relentless march of time pressing upon every weathered stone, as if the centuries themselves were whispering their goodbyes. （读后续写·古迹·时间流逝的沧桑）

posExamples.sentence: Drums thundering and banners aloft, the whole team marched down the sunlit street, their heads held high and their voices rising into one triumphant roar that echoed off every building. （读后续写·游行狂欢·画面感）
I would therefore like to propose that on National Fitness Day we march together from the school gate to the city square, spreading the joyful message that exercise belongs to everyone. （应用文·倡议书）
The peaceful march for climate action demonstrated that when ordinary citizens unite behind a common cause, their collective voice can no longer be ignored by those in power. （议论文·公民行动主题）
Furious at the unfair result, he marched straight up to the referee, demanding an explanation before the whole silent stadium. （读后续写·体育冲突·愤怒动作）

idioms.translation: 在行军中；在进行中，在发展中
idioms.example: As spring advanced, life was visibly on the march everywhere — buds swelling, streams quickening, and the whole valley stirring back to green. （读后续写·季节·生机复苏）
By launching their eco-project a week early, the rival class stole a march on us and won the school's green award. （读后续写·校园竞争）
When the manager discovered the theft, he gave the dishonest clerk his marching orders on the spot. （读后续写·职场·被辞退）

collocations.example: The costumed dancers marched down the street, sequins flashing like a river of light under the tropical sun. （读后续写·嘉年华）
As the honour guard marched past the memorial, a hush of respect settled over the entire crowd. （读后续写·纪念仪式）
Undeterred by the storm, the explorers marched on towards the distant ridge, their boots sinking into the endless snow. （读后续写·探险·坚持）
Insulted by the remark, she marched off without so much as a backward glance. （读后续写·情绪·负气离开）
Thousands marched in protest against the closure of the old public library that had nourished the community for a century. （议论文·公共利益）

collocations.translation: 抗议游行 / 和平游行
collocations.example: Organizing a peace march is one way for students to channel their idealism into meaningful civic engagement. （应用文·活动倡议）
By dawn the volunteers stood in marching order, backpacks strapped tight, ready to set out for the flood-hit village. （读后续写·救灾·出发）

collocations.phrase: the march of progress / history / time
collocations.translation: 进步 / 历史 / 时间的进程
collocations.example: No individual, however powerful, can halt the march of progress once an idea has captured people's hearts. （议论文·历史发展观）

synonyms.example: The winning float paraded slowly through the square while children waved flags from every balcony. （读后续写·庆典）
synonyms.usage: 侧重庆祝、展示性的盛装列队；march 侧重齐步、有节奏或有明确目的（军队/抗议）的行进

synonyms.example: He strode across the room with an air of unshakeable confidence, every step announcing that he had already made up his mind. （读后续写·人物气场）
synonyms.usage: 侧重单人步幅大、有气势的走法；march 强调节奏一致或群体性、目的性

synonyms.example: As the troops advanced under cover of night, an uneasy silence gripped the sleeping town. （读后续写·紧张推进）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，侧重朝目标（尤其军事或抽象目标）向前推进的方向感；march 更强调具体的走的动作

advancedExpressions.expression: with ... aloft and ... thundering, sb. marched ...
advancedExpressions.example: With banners aloft and drums thundering, the crowd marched forward as one, and for a fleeting moment I felt I belonged to something far greater than myself. （独立主格伴随状语 + as one 强调团结，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us march side by side to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us march side by side to make our campus greener, for change begins the moment we take the first step together. （祈使呼吁 + 比喻 first step，倡议信结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing can halt the march of ...
advancedExpressions.example: History teaches us that nothing can halt the march of an idea whose time has come. （借历史经验立论，march of 抽象化用法增强思辨感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The group walked down the street together.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Shoulder to shoulder, the group marched down the street, their footsteps falling into a single joyful rhythm that seemed to make the very pavement pulse with life. （读后续写·群体动作+画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Shoulder to shoulder 状语前置渲染团结 + 拟人(pavement pulse with life) + 用 march 替换 walk 提升力度与节奏感

sentenceUpgrade.original: People marched to ask the government to protect the forest.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Determined to give voice to the voiceless, thousands marched in solemn protest, urging the authorities to safeguard the ancient forest before it was lost to us forever. （议论文/应用文·公共议题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Determined to... 分词状语交代动机 + give voice to the voiceless 修辞短语 + before 从句制造紧迫感

original_sentence: The Carnival current carried us through the ever‑growing sea of people, dancing all the way.
readingExamples: The Carnival current carried us through the ever‑growing sea of people, dancing all the way.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a continuous flowing movement of water, air, or electricity in a particular direction
(2) n. a general tendency or course of events, opinions, or feelings
(3) adj. happening or existing now; belonging to the present time
(4) adj. generally accepted or in common use at the present time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （货币、票据等）现行流通的，通用的
uncommonMeanings.example: The old coins were no longer current, yet the grandmother kept them in a velvet pouch, each one a small doorway back into a vanished world. （读后续写·怀旧·旧物寄情）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情感、思想中潜藏的）暗流，潜流
uncommonMeanings.example: Beneath his polite smile ran a current of resentment that he could no longer quite conceal. （读后续写·人物心理·隐藏情绪）

posExamples.sentence: The festive current carried us through the ever-growing sea of dancers, and before I knew it, my feet had surrendered to the rhythm and my worries had melted into the music. （读后续写·嘉年华·随波逐流的沉醉）
I am writing to share my views on the current practice of assigning excessive homework, which, in my humble opinion, deserves serious rethinking by both teachers and parents. （应用文·建议信）
Under current circumstances, where information travels faster than ever, the ability to think critically is no longer a luxury but an absolute necessity. （议论文·信息时代主题）
A powerful current suddenly seized the small boat, and for one heart-stopping moment the fishermen were sure the river would swallow them whole. （读后续写·遇险·惊险瞬间）

idioms.translation: 逆流而行；反潮流，特立独行
idioms.example: While her classmates all chased the same fashionable major, she chose to swim against the current and follow her love of ancient languages. （读后续写·坚持自我）
It is easy to go with the current and stay silent, but true character reveals itself the moment we dare to speak up. （议论文·独立人格）

collocations.translation: 洋流 / 海流 / 河水
collocations.example: The lifeguard warned us that a hidden river current had swept many a strong swimmer far from shore. （读后续写·水域·警示）
A sudden surge of electric current plunged the whole laboratory into darkness just as the experiment reached its climax. （读后续写·实验·突发）
Rowing against the current tested every ounce of the boy's strength, yet he refused to let the oars slip from his blistered hands. （读后续写·坚持·体力考验）
Given the current situation, it is advisable that we adopt a more flexible plan for the outdoor field trip. （应用文·活动方案）
Reading about current affairs every morning has broadened my horizons and sharpened my sense of social responsibility. （应用文·经验分享）

synonyms.example: The two sisters saved for years before they could buy a modest flat on the outskirts of London. （读后续写·奋斗）

translation: 寻找，搜寻；打猎，猎杀；追捕
sub_section: A: The Gift of the Magi
original_sentence: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift.
readingExamples: She spent the next two hours hunting for Jim's gift.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to chase and kill wild animals or birds for food, sport, or profit
(2) v. to search carefully for something that is difficult to find
(3) v. to search for and try to catch a criminal or an enemy

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 追捕；搜捕（罪犯／敌人）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 搜寻；狩猎活动
uncommonMeanings.example: The treasure hunt her grandfather had designed led the children from the attic to the old apple tree, each clue soaked in memories of summers long gone. （读后续写·童年回忆）

posExamples.sentence: She spent the whole afternoon hunting for a gift worthy of Jim, going in and out of every shop until, at last, her eyes fell upon a simple watch chain that made her heart leap. （读后续写·寻礼）

original_sentence: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch
readingExamples: She found it at last: a simple but beautiful watch chain for his gold watch
definitionEn:
(1) n. a series of connected metal rings, used for fastening, pulling, or as jewellery
(2) n. a group of shops, hotels, or businesses owned by the same company
(3) n. a connected series of things or events

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 用链子拴住；束缚

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., passed down from ... to ..., still ...

original_sentence: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
readingExamples: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
definitionEn:
(1) n. the money that a person, family, or organization earns, usually through work or investments
(2) n. money received during a particular period, especially in return for work or from investment
(3) n. (economics) the flow of money going to an individual or group over a period of time

posExamples.sentence: With an income of just twenty dollars a week, the young couple counted every coin, yet somehow their tiny apartment always overflowed with a happiness the rich could not buy. （读后续写·贫寒温情）

A widening gap between high and low incomes not only breeds resentment but also threatens the very stability on which a healthy society depends. （议论文·贫富差距）
When his father lost his only source of income, the boy quietly took on two paper routes, determined that his little sister would never go without her morning milk. （读后续写·担当）

collocations.example: The small orchard was the family's only source of income, so when the hailstorm struck, they watched their livelihood being battered to the ground. （读后续写·天灾）
Growing up in a low-income household taught her the value of every hard-earned coin, a lesson no textbook could ever match. （读后续写·成长）
By selling her handmade cards after school, she earned a small income that felt, to her, as precious as a fortune. （读后续写·自立）
After years of odd jobs, he finally landed a position with a steady income, and for the first time in a decade he slept without worry. （读后续写·安稳）
Narrowing the income gap is not merely an economic goal but a moral one, for no child should be denied opportunity by the accident of birth. （议论文·公平）
As families' disposable income rises, more parents are willing to invest in their children's music and art education. （议论文·消费）
Our charity aims to provide free winter coats for children from low-income families before the first snow arrives. （应用文·倡议书）
To supplement the family income, Mother took in sewing late at night, the soft hum of the machine becoming the lullaby of my childhood. （读后续写·母爱）

synonyms.example: He set aside a portion of his monthly earnings for his sister's tuition, never once mentioning the sacrifice to anyone. （读后续写·无私）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:earnings 特指‘通过劳动挣得的钱（工资、报酬）’，强调‘挣’的来源；income 更宽泛，包括工资、投资、租金等一切进项。

synonyms.example: Though the salary was far from generous, the sense of purpose the job gave her was worth more than any figure on a payslip. （读后续写·价值观）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:salary 是专业岗位的‘固定薪水’（通常按月／年）；income 是总收入的上位词，含 salary、wages、投资收益等所有来源。

synonyms.example: The festival brought in record revenue for the town, funding new libraries and mending its long-neglected roads. （议论文·经济）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:revenue 多指企业营收或政府税收（组织层面）；income 既可指个人也可指组织，谈个人收入时用 income，不用 revenue。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·贫寒中的坚韧
advancedExpressions.expression: with an income of ..., yet ...

advancedExpressions.expression: hoping to earn a modest income that will ...

advancedExpressions.expression: a widening gap between ... incomes threatens ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Their weekly income of twenty dollars stretched thin over rent, coal and bread, and yet, when night fell and the lamp glowed warm, the little apartment seemed richer than any mansion — for it was filled with a love that no wage could ever measure. （读后续写·安贫乐道）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: stretch thin over 具象化拮据 + and yet 转折 + 破折号补充because从句 + 对比升华(richer than any mansion)

original_sentence: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
readingExamples: With an income of twenty dollars per week, life was hard for the couple
definitionEn:
(1) prep. for each (used when expressing rates, prices, or measurements)
(2) prep. according to; in accordance with (as in 'as per')
(3) prep. by means of; through the agency of (formal, as in 'per post')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 按照，根据（常见于 as per）
uncommonMeanings.example: As per your instructions, I had every lantern hung along the courtyard wall before dusk — yet when Grandma finally arrived, she paused, her eyes glistening, and whispered that the sight was far lovelier than she had ever imagined. （读后续写·节日筹备·惊喜）

posExamples.sentence: The old craftsman charged only ten yuan per lantern, yet each one he handed over carried hours of patient labour and a warmth that no price could ever measure. （读后续写·匠人·温情）

Statistics reveal that an average teenager now spends over five hours per day on electronic screens — a figure that ought to alarm every parent and educator alike. （议论文·青少年与科技）
As per the schedule attached, our volunteer team will visit the nursing home twice per month, bringing not only fresh fruit but also the companionship the elderly residents cherish most. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.translation: 每周 / 每月 / 每年

Over the past decade, the per capita income in this once-impoverished county has trebled, transforming muddy footpaths into bustling market streets. （议论文·脱贫·经济）
A recent survey found that nearly seventy per cent of respondents were unable to name three traditional Chinese festivals, a result both surprising and thought-provoking. （议论文·传统文化）
Working sixteen hours per day, the delivery rider pedalled through wind and rain so that his daughter could one day sit in a warm classroom. （读后续写·父爱·奋斗）
The high-speed train glided along at three hundred kilometres per hour, and the golden rice fields blurred past the window like a river of light. （读后续写·旅途·画面感）
As per the committee's decision, each class will prepare one traditional performance for the Double Ninth celebration. （应用文·通知）
By lowering the cost per item, the student cooperative managed to sell out its handmade cards within a single afternoon. （应用文·活动报告）

synonyms.example: The teacher handed each child a paper lantern, and their faces lit up as brightly as the candles they were about to light. （读后续写·课堂·童趣）
synonyms.usage: each 是日常通用词，可作限定词或代词；per 更正式，专用于表示比率、单价、频率（如 per week），不能单独指代人或物

synonyms.example: The workers were paid fifty yuan an hour, a rate that finally allowed them to send something home. （读后续写·打工·生计）
synonyms.usage: 口语中常用 a/an 代替 per 表比率（an hour = per hour）；per 更书面、正式，多见于合同、报告、通知等文体

synonyms.example: According to the ancient custom, families climb high mountains on the Double Ninth Festival to pray for health and longevity. （应用文·文化介绍）
synonyms.usage: according to 表示'依据某来源/规定'，语义完整独立；per 仅在 as per 结构中才有此义，且更简洁、正式

advancedExpressions.expression: at a rate of ... per ..., sb. did ...
advancedExpressions.example: At a rate of a thousand steps per minute, her heart raced up the mountain path, each breath a silent vow that she would not give up before reaching the summit. （比率短语具象化心跳节奏，读后续写渲染紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: the charge / fee is fixed at ... per ...

advancedExpressions.expression: with an average of ... per ..., it is evident that ...

original_sentence: He thought of the beautiful set of combs on show in one of the shop windows on Broadway.
readingExamples: He thought of the beautiful set of combs on show in one of the shop windows on Broadway.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flat piece of plastic, metal or wood with a row of thin teeth, used for making the hair tidy
(2) v. to make the hair tidy and smooth with a comb
(3) v. to search a place very carefully in order to find someone or something
(4) n. the soft red part on top of a cock's head (a bird's crest)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （公鸡头顶的）肉冠；鸡冠

posExamples.sentence: Della gazed at the beautiful set of tortoiseshell combs in the shop window, her fingers pressed against the cold glass, longing for what her empty purse could never buy. （读后续写·渴望·情感）

synonyms.usage: brush 用刷子，动作范围更广（刷衣、刷牙、刷漆均可）；comb 用梳子，专指用密齿工具整理，且引申义'地毯式搜寻'是 brush 所没有的

original_sentence: went to the shop for the combs and returned home with a package in his pocket

definitionEn:
